notes.note: Reviewed the compile-target check in the Tauri adapter and the desktop-only Rust replay commands. Android and iOS skip subscription after a valid report. The desktop subscribe-before-drain replay path retains its early mount and acknowledgement.

Reviewed direct-origin, media-type, and Station-envelope checks in SDK credential reporting. The runtime marks its own JSON and removes markers from relayed responses. Native authenticated transport preserves the marker and declines redirects. The app still records refusals and uses verified, generation-bound successes to recover.

Reviewed tray subscription against Android compile-target reporting and the desktop replay contract. Android and iOS use a no-op subscription after a valid capability report. Desktop still subscribes, drains, validates and acknowledges pending destinations.
